notes.title: Update 02.07.24
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44308177/ca022a8fcdfc0652d6b0db2b44c30817e114eb30.jpg[/img]

Update V 1.04 

List of bug fixes and improvements for this update:  
— Fixed the behavior of the snail on the first level after the third save point. The snail no longer gets stuck on the platform edge if Martha is clinging to the same edge at the moment  
— Fixed some minor details at the start of level six
— Optimized the objects positioning in the foreground: they no longer interfere with the filed of view while moving

Additionally: 
— Added an icon for saving and adding information into the Notebook
— Fixed a bug with taking damage from spikes at level eight
— Added a sound effect when entering a cave in specific locations

Thank you for your suggestions and bug reports! We always pay attention to your feedback and try our best to take all your messages into account.

notes.title: Update 18.06.24
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44308177/8c13de9f3bdada1359a3b58ed5093b0fddbd46da.png[/img]
Update V 1.03

This update fixes the following bugs:

— Blackie freezing when fighting the Main Boss
— Newborn Blackies not attacking Martha after the Boss Blackie is defeated
— Boss Scolopendra’s attacks pushing Martha up or outside the level limits 
— Wrong enemy attacks direction
— Enemies being able to move above surfaces
— The HP scale of the Main Boss obscuring the lower part of the arena
— Whip clinging to a platform instead of a hook on level 4
— Wrong camera movement upon being killed by a stone pillar
— On repeated playthroughs, if the player returned home from level 2 and entered the door, the player would be teleported to the end of the level

— Disabled certain clues appearing on repeated playthroughs

notes.title: Update 11.06.24
notes.content:
Update V 1.02

List of bug fixes and improvements for the 1.02 update:

— Fixed a bug where cutting a log on the first level could lead to falling with it and getting stuck 
— Fixed a bug where in the gorge on the first level players could hook on a wall and jump high up in the air 
— The blackies that are spawned by the Boss-blackie no longer give health points 
— Fixed a bug where you could hook onto a ledge from the other side
— Fixed a bug where some blackies could be defeated in multiple hits — now all blackies are defeated with one hit
— Fixed a bug where players could get stuck in spikes when falling on them 
— Fixed a bug where players could hook on a section of wall above the marked area 
— Fixed a number of typos in the in-game texts
— Improved the quality of sounds

notes.title: Update 03.06.24
notes.content:
Update V 1.01

Dear players, we continue to improve our game and fix the bugs we found. 
Thank you for playing JustAxe, we would be glad if you share your feedback and tell us about your experience with the game! 

These are the important changes in the 1.01 update: 
1) Shiny things no longer restore health
2) Reduced the number of health points dropped when defeating the Dog
3) Health points dropped from enemies now restore less health on the overall scale
4) Falling rocks and lowering platforms now do more damage
5) Made the mechanics of fighting the Maggot more complex
6) Shifted the position of one shiny thing on the first level to make collecting all of the shiny things a little easier
7) The little Blackies that appear from the Boss Blackie no longer drop health points
8) Removed a few hearts on the first level
9) Added a few extra Blackies on the first level
10) Fixed a number of bugs
11) Improved stability

We hope that your new year will be filled with joyful moments, and your loved ones will always be by your side. And if any monsters tried to disturb your peace, may you always find the strength to fight them off, just like Marta 🪓

Thank you for playing Just Axe Demo and letting us know about problems!

We wish you a happy and memorable holiday season!

notes.title: JustAxe: official livestream coming soon!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44308177/70a6501b26166bd382ff15316fe26930af528bd9.png[/img]

Shall we play? On October 11 and 13 at 12:00 GMT, we will host an online meeting with the development team.

A small town, hidden in the forest behind the mountains, lived quietly and peacefully, until the tranquility of the townsfolk was disrupted by a mysterious invasion of creatures from another world. Hostile creatures kidnap the main heroine’s sister. But all is not lost! One day she receives a mysterious letter whose author seems to know how to resolve the situation... Grab an axe and go on an adventure!

Join the celebration of the “Steam Next Fest” — a festival of new games!
We’ll see you on our livestream! ;)
